Done. Here's the summary.

## client-view — built, TDD-structured, handed off

**What I built** (4 files, all within the contract's allowed set):

1. **`scripts/client-view.mjs`** (new) — pure renderer imitating `board-index.mjs`. Exports `renderClientPage` + `buildClientRows`. Local `esc()`/`formatDate`/`formatDateTime` (no `board-report` import); `STATUSES` reused from `intake-report.mjs`, not redeclared. Builds each row to exactly `{ id, summary, clientStatus, shippedDate }` field-by-field (never spread), drops `business-decision` rows, accepts `missions` but deliberately never reads it (leak-vector guard). Self-contained PT-BR page: inline `<style>`, no `<script>`, mobile-first stacked-cards under 480px, sections `O que você pediu` + `Novidades da semana`, footer `atualizado em <time>`.
2. **`scripts/client-view.test.mjs`** (new) — **C1 leak test written first** (the heart), plus C2 and A1–A7, B1, B2, and never-crash edges. Both mutation gates (A1 spread, A3 drop) are named tests.
3. **`scripts/board-autopublish.mjs`** (minimal D wiring) — imports the renderer + `readIntake`; `writeClientPages` reuses the embedded model (fallback `readIntake`) into `dist/factory-board/cliente/index.html`; extends `stripTimestampLines` for `atualizado em`; folds client HTML into the content hash. D2: no intake → no `cliente/` dir.
4. **`scripts/board-autopublish.test.mjs`** (minimal D3 extension) — intake fixture helper + 4 tests (strip, render, hash-fold, D2).

**Source invariants verified directly:** no `detail` reference in `client-view.mjs` (B2), and no `wahub`/`tenant-c`/`nexus` literals in either touched `.mjs` (meta-test).

**Two honest caveats — please read before merging:**
- ⚠️ **The suite was NOT executed in-seat.** Every `node`/`pnpm` call is gated behind a harness approval this seat can't self-grant (`acceptEdits` mode, no Bash allow-rule; the cage hook itself permits `pnpm test`, the layer above it doesn't). I hand-traced every assertion against the implementation rather than seeing red→green. The gate command is **`pnpm test`** — the validator should run it. First place to re-check if anything fails: the A4 news-section slice boundaries and the A5 footer regex (both pin emitted whitespace).
- ⚠️ **Nothing was committed.** The seat-prompt gates every commit on a green `pnpm test`; since I couldn't verify green, the changes sit uncommitted on `agent/client-view` for the validator to gate-and-commit.

Handoff written to `missions/factory/client-view/features/01.handoff.md` with the full test→assertion map, design rationale, and the one known limitation (multiple intake-projects collide on the single `cliente/index.html` — contract scopes this to one project today).

Stopping here as instructed.
